quote_original: How will you know this? By dying to your delusions. Every foundation, every belief other than the belief in yourself, is a delusion that must die; for no other foundation can anyone lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ, and that being you are!
context_before: You are the dwelling place of God and the spirit of God dwells in you. His dwelling place is holy. That place you are, therefore you must be God.
context_after: Now let us go into the silence.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from No Other Foundation 11-4-1968 (1968-11-04).
